title: reproducible_synthetic_ehr
summary: A research repository providing reproducible example scripts and notebooks for generating synthetic electronic health records (EHR) from the MIMIC-III dataset using multiple generative methods (corgan, medgan, halo, promptehr, realtabformer). One example script directly imports SDV's single-table API to fit CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer on flattened EHR data, running SDV as one of several synthetic-data generators compared.
evidence: prs/examples/generate_synthetic_mimic3_gpt2.py:275-289 imports sdv.single_table CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer, fits and samples synthetic EHR data
